description_en: Queries the list of resources owned by a user
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-user-resources --client-id 54c17e1d-2d72-4b87-aa33-25f3b3f20000 --client-type windows --client-version 7.6.0-R-20241112.222305 --login-token v18101ac6a9e69c66b04a163031680463660b4b216cd758f34b60b9ad6a7c7f7334b83dd8f75eef4209c68f9f1080b0000 --session-id cd45e873-650d-4d70-acb9-f996187a0000 --login-region-id cn-hangzhou --search-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-ids cn-hangzhou+dir-54400000 --resource-types Desktop --product-types CloudApp --resource-ids ecd-00001 --resource-name testName --protocol-type ASP --access-type INTERNET --biz-language zh-CN --category-type 1 --category-id 0 --query-fota-update false --refresh-fota-update false --order-by AssignTime --sort-type ASC --max-results 500 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --auto-refresh false --scene desktop --dual-center-forward false --query-desktop-timers true --query-desktop-duration-list true --api-version 2020-10-02 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserResources

parameters.help_en: The unique ID generated by the client. You can use a UUID. This parameter is not a sensitive field and does not need to be encrypted
parameters.help_zh: 客户端生成的唯一ID，参考UUID。该参数非敏感字段，无需加密
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the client
parameters.help_zh: 客户端的类型
parameters.name: client_type

parameters.help_en: The client version
parameters.help_zh: 客户端版本
parameters.name: client_version

parameters.help_en: The logon token
parameters.help_zh:
登录凭证。
通过`GetLoginToken`接口登录获取，或登录后通过更新接口`RefreshLoginToken`获取。返回参数：LoginToken
parameters.name: login_token

parameters.help_en: The session ID. You can obtain this value by calling the `GetLoginToken` operation
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID。调用`GetLoginToken`接口获取
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID for logon, used in the office network ID logon scenario. This parameter is not required for the organization ID logon scenario
parameters.help_zh: 登录的地域ID，用于办公网络ID登录场景。组织ID登录场景无需填写
parameters.name: login_region_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID used to filter cloud resources in a specified region
parameters.help_zh: 搜索地域ID。用于过滤出指定地域的云资源信息
parameters.name: search_region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of office network IDs. Specify this parameter when you log on with an AD account
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID列表。AD账号登录时填写
parameters.name: office_site_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of resource types. If this parameter is empty, all resource types are queried
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型列表，为空则查询所有资源类型
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The list of product types. If this parameter is empty, all product types are queried
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型列表，为空则查询所有产品类型
parameters.name: product_types

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID列表。
可设置0\~100个
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The resource name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 资源名称，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: resource_name

parameters.help_en: The protocol type. This parameter is used only to filter cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh: 协议类型。该参数仅用于过滤云电脑
parameters.name: protocol_type

parameters.help_en: The access type. If not specified, both types are displayed
parameters.help_zh: 接入类型，不传表示两种都显示
parameters.name: access_type

parameters.help_en: The client language
parameters.help_zh: 客户端语言
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The primary resource category
parameters.help_zh: 资源一级类目
parameters.name: category_type

parameters.help_en: The secondary resource category
parameters.help_zh: 资源二级类目
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query cloud desktop image version information
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询云电脑镜像版本信息
parameters.name: query_fota_update

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to refresh OTA information in real time
parameters.help_zh: 是否实时刷新OTA信息
parameters.name: refresh_fota_update

parameters.help_en: The sort field. If not specified, results are sorted by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，若不指定则按照创建时间倒序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式
parameters.name: sort_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。   默认值500
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page
parameters.help_zh: 下一页Token
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to refresh immediately
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即刷新。

为了保证接口响应速度，建议传入`false`
parameters.name: auto_refresh

parameters.help_en: The client scenario, used to identify the sort order. Set this parameter to `desktop`
parameters.help_zh: 客户端场景，用于标识排序。请传入`desktop`
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable dual-center forwarding. Set this parameter to `false`
parameters.help_zh: 是否双中心转发。请传入`false`
parameters.name: dual_center_forward

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query cloud desktop scheduled task information. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询云电脑定时任务信息，默认为true
parameters.name: query_desktop_timers

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query Cloud Desktop resource plan information. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询云桌面套餐包信息，默认为true
parameters.name: query_desktop_duration_list
